title: Who is involved: Don't Panic Festival

story.text:
# Who is involved

**Active cast.** The strategy group itself (near-midnight session owing material). Hosts who "drop a pin" become "owner-members" running their own expression. Content-makers: storytellers, "buskers guided tour speakers stand-up poets," "spoken word people," board-game hosts, comedians doing "a bit"; chefs commissioned for "last meal before the end of the universe" menus; three-star Michelin dumpster-truck dinners; people who "host dinner parties for cash." Mythos agent Marvin acts as the funded "main character" whose worst-case list gets reversed. "Audrey Tang" appears on the EthMumbai/Devcon main stage; "Vitalik" wanted talking on stage. Named contact "Nickelina" runs the hub network. "Henry" and "Robbie" are owed the material and report.

**Being invited or network activated.** "Local radio stations all around the world" (the key partner: "get one of them involved and you've almost got a festival"), local newspapers, streaming partners "nts" and "bbc radio 6," a possible Mumbai Hitchhiker radio station or podcast; the ~50,000-farm northern-India regenerative network; local food-delivery apps and sponsors; the hub network (~12, recently ~40 spaces) grown toward 42 / 420,000; the Ethereum Foundation and Swarm/Gnosis; a possible follow-up farm-to-food hackathon.
See [[Don't Panic Festival]]  ·  hub: [[Who is Involved?]]
